owner.description: User id the key belongs to (bills to, listed under). Always a user; a child key inherits its parent's owner.

createdBy.description: Who minted the key — `USER#<id>` (dashboard), `API_KEY#<fingerprint>` (another key), `AEP#<did>` (AEP grant) — an actor id: `USER#<userId>` (dashboard), `API_KEY#<fingerprint>` (another key), `AEP#<did>` (an enrolled agent), `CLERK`, `SYSTEM`.

scopes.description: Scope grants: `{resource}:{action}` over runs, resources, wallet, topups, controls and api_keys with read/create/update/delete, plus `{resource}:*` and `*`. Catalog reads need no scope. Fixed at creation.

status.description: ACTIVE, EXPIRED (derived from expiresAt) or REVOKED. Only ACTIVE keys authenticate.

origin.description: Channel the key was minted through — derived from `createdBy`: DASHBOARD, API, AEP or SYSTEM.

revokedAt.description: When the key was revoked. Present only when REVOKED.

revokedBy.description: Who revoked the key (present only when REVOKED) — an actor id: `USER#<userId>` (dashboard), `API_KEY#<fingerprint>` (another key), `AEP#<did>` (an enrolled agent), `CLERK`, `SYSTEM`.

lastUsedAt.description: Last time the key authenticated a request. Absent if never used.
